There are multiple bridges over Boulder Creek in and near the city of Boulder, Colorado, and “Boulder Creek Bridge” can refer to different structures depending on era and location. To make sure I give you the right and complete information, which of the following do you mean?

- A specific historic bridge (for example a bridge listed on the National Register of Historic Places)
- A particular street/road crossing (examples: 9th Street, Canyon Boulevard, Arapahoe Avenue, Broadway, or another)
- A pedestrian/bicycle bridge on the Boulder Creek Path
- The major highway bridges that cross Boulder Creek (e.g., on CO-93 or US routes)
- A general history and overview of bridges spanning Boulder Creek through time

If you’re not sure which one, tell me any detail you have (an approximate location, a photo, the era, or whether it’s motor-vehicle vs. pedestrian). Once you tell me which bridge you want, I’ll provide full details: location, dimensions and design, date built, architects/engineers/builder, historical significance, alterations, current condition/status (including National Register or local register listings if applicable), and sources.
